points.description: States that piggybacking requires two-way (full-duplex or semi-duplex) communication between sender and receiver, so data frames can travel in both directions. Equivalent wording such as 'bidirectional link' earns the mark. Also accepted: stating that frames must contain an extra acknowledgement field.

rubric.notes: Full mark for naming the two-way (full or semi-duplex) link requirement, or the extra acknowledgement field in frames. The model answer offers either as acceptable, so a student who gives either one earns the mark. No partial credit, since the question is worth a single mark.
